# Who is carrying the pager, and how much of it didn't need to wake anyone?

> Free on-call load analyzer: paste a PagerDuty, Opsgenie or Grafana OnCall incident CSV and see who carries the pager, night and weekend pages, noisy and self-resolving alerts, and the hours a cleanup would give back. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/oncall-load-analyzer/)
